added.statement: Home Manager shall provide a jcode-tui command that attaches to one named tmux session and launches the full J-Code TUI client only when that session does not exist.
acceptance_criteria: jcode-tui resolves from the activated user PATH
two invocations target the same tmux session named jcode-ui
the tmux pane runs the full J-Code TUI client rather than jcode connect
the TUI registers against the existing jcode-server.service socket

ears.trigger: an SSH or WebTTY client invokes jcode-tui
ears.response: attach to the existing jcode-ui tmux session or create it with one full J-Code TUI client

breaker.condition: a second invocation creates a different tmux TUI or launches the line-oriented connect client

added.statement: The managed J-Code WebTTY service shall listen only on 127.0.0.1:7681 and shall run jcode-tui as a writable terminal with same-origin checking.
acceptance_criteria: systemd reports jcode-webtty.service active
ss reports exactly one ttyd listener at 127.0.0.1:7681
curl to http://127.0.0.1:7681 returns the ttyd terminal page
no listener exists on 0.0.0.0:7681, [::]:7681, or a public host address

ears.response: serve a writable same-origin browser terminal only on the IPv4 loopback address

breaker.condition: ttyd accepts connections through a non-loopback listener

added.statement: The WebTTY and shared TUI shall reuse the existing J-Code daemon and shall not create, replace, or stop jcode-server.service.
acceptance_criteria: jcode-server.service remains active with NRestarts unchanged during attachment
exactly one process has the J-Code serve subcommand
the shared TUI appears as a client in jcode debug clients:map
stopping jcode-webtty.service leaves jcode-server.service active

ears.trigger: an SSH or browser client attaches
ears.response: reuse the existing daemon without starting or stopping a serve process

breaker.condition: attachment creates another serve process or disrupts the active daemon
